sources.locator: §1.1 Renewal theory for cast + auto timing schedules (lines 59-68)
sources.quote: Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed *and* no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it *starts* within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`). With `c_i` the effective cooldown of ability `i`, the cast epochs of a solo ability are `0, c_i, 2c_i, …` — again a deterministic renewal schedule; the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.
Ability rotation casts (`_schedule_shared_casts`, `_compute_ability_rotation`) | shared-timeline renewal schedule; cast starts within window | EXACT | ... R single-cast

sources.file: CLAUDE.md (domain knowledge, restated in docs/math-foundations.md usage)

scenario_reading.'120': the Transcendent splinters option set to its capstone value 120 (range 0-120 per S7). 120 >= 40, so the synthetic Q2 second-charge slot is live (S3, S6, S7).
scenario_reading.'custom_order': a user-supplied cast-order (priority) list consumed by the greedy shared-timeline scheduler (S1). The order permutes which slot occupies indices 0-4 of the opening but does not change the *set* of slots castable at t=0, which is what determines index 5 and 6.
scenario_reading.assumed_level_and_ranks: 18 / Q5 W5 E5 R3 (18 points = 5+5+5+3), the standard golden loadout for a mid champion. Robustness over levels and haste is checked below.

step_1_effective_cooldowns.Q: base 7 s at every rank (S3). R's passive grants Dark Sphere a dedicated 10/20/30 ability haste (S4); at R rank 3 that is +30 AH. With no item haste: 7 * 100 / (100 + 30) = 5.3846 s per charge.
step_1_effective_cooldowns.R: rank 3 -> 80 s, but the engine casts R once per fight (S2, 'R single-cast'), so R never returns inside the window

step_2_charge_model.claim: Q is an ammo/charge ability at splinters >= 40 with max 2 charges, recharging ONE charge per 7 s recharge period, sequentially.
step_2_charge_model.source: S3 wiki text 'periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2' + rechargeRate [7,7,7,7,7]; S7 classifies it as an 'ammo' atom.
step_2_charge_model.consequence: Spending both charges at t~0 returns charge 1 at t0 + r and charge 2 at t0 + 2r (r = 5.3846 s), NOT both at t0 + r.

step_3_opening_burst.indices: 0,1,2,3,4 (their internal order is exactly what the custom order dictates; irrelevant to the identity of index 6)
step_3_opening_burst.elapsed: cast times sum to 0.25 (E) + 0.25 (R) + 0 (Q) + 0 (Q2) + 0 (W) = 0.50 s, so every opening cast starts in [0, 0.50] s (S1: 'each cast occupies its sourced cast time')

step_5_result.index_6: W  (Force of Will off its 8 s cooldown, ~8.0-8.5 s)

step_6_haste_robustness_proof.statement: For any external ability haste H >= 0, W's second cast precedes Q's third cast, and Q's first recharge precedes W's second cast; therefore index 5 = Q and index 6 = W.

independent_computation.step_7_level_robustness: The ordering needs cd_W < 2 * r_Q. At any level where R is ranked 3 (>= 16), W is at rank 3+ (cd <= 10 s) and 2*r_Q = 10.77 s, so W still lands first. At R rank 1 (+10 AH): r_Q = 6.364 s, 2*r_Q = 12.73 s > W rank 1's 11 s (rank 2 -> 11 s, rank 1 -> 12 s is the only tie-adjacent case and still resolves W-first at 12 < 12.73). The result is stable across the realistic level/rank ladder.

reconstructed_failure_modes: The Q2 second-charge slot missing from the opening (splinters=120 gate not applied). Opening becomes 4 casts {Q,W,E,R} -> index 4 = Q@5.385, index 5 = W@8.000, index 6 = Q@10.769. That reproduces the old 'Q' exactly.
Parallel charge regeneration (both Q charges returning at t0 + r instead of t0 + r and t0 + 2r). Then index 5 = Q, index 6 = Q(2nd charge) -> old 'Q'.
why_the_old_value_Q_arises.both_are_contradicted_by: S3 ('periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2' = one charge per 7 s period) and S6/S7 (the Q2 slot is live at splinters >= 40, and the scenario pins splinters at 120).

caveats: The scenario tuple itself (level, items, and the literal custom order list) lives outside the permitted evidence tree; it was reconstructed from the scenario id plus data/champion-audit. The conclusion was then proven invariant to ability haste (any H >= 0), to the internal permutation of the opening burst, and across the realistic rank ladder, so it does not depend on that reconstruction.

data/champions.json marks Syndra Q cooldown 'affectedByCdr: false'. Taken literally (Q reduced only by R's dedicated haste), index 6 stays W for all external haste below ~49 AH and flips to Q above it. That literal reading is contradicted by the R passive text (S4), which states Dark Sphere's cooldown responds to ability haste; the flag matches the wiki's ammo-ability convention seen on Amumu Q / Gangplank E / Vi E, where the 'cooldown' field is the static inter-cast lockout and rechargeRate is the real timer. Under either reading at zero-to-moderate haste, index 6 = W.
